seo.description: Ten lifts and 38 runs on the edge of the Vindelfjällen nature reserve in Västerbotten, with three children's areas and 65 km of cross-country track.

h1: Hemavan Tärnaby ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Hemavan sits on the edge of the Vindelfjällen nature reserve near the Norwegian border, with ten lifts including a gondola, 38 runs and three separate children's areas. Sixty-five kilometres of cross-country track run from the village, some of it floodlit, and Tärnaby lies eighteen kilometres down the valley.
stayOverview: Hemavan has the gondola and the children's areas; Tärnaby, eighteen kilometres down the valley, has the Fjällhotell and the Sporthotell and is the quieter and cheaper of the two.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. The two villages are a drive apart, so pick the one whose lifts you actually want to use.
rentalCars: A car is useful for moving between Hemavan and Tärnaby, which are eighteen kilometres apart on the E12.
